decisions.reason: The candidate already allocates the primary-mint prize contribution exclusively to Small Block; message 210 does not change the mint-price allocation.
Message 210 restates the existing Transak conversion and mint-fulfillment behavior but does not change its values or resume the deferred integration.
The complete same-message MODIFY already captures the new emailed cashout guidance; the remaining wallet provisioning and access details are unchanged restatements.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already captures the revised Small Block, ticket, referral, payout, and fiat-buyer FAQ content.
Message 210 does not discuss or alter the optional tipping behavior.
The candidate already specifies one $500 prize every 100 sales and a $5 primary-mint pool contribution; message 210 does not necessarily change its funding sources or other current mechanics.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already replaces the prior Small Block counter representation with one ticket per successful referral and expiration after the current draw.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already captures selection of one affiliate from the applicable 100-sales block using referral tickets.
Message 210 describes rewards for successful referrals but does not change the separate no-referral random-allocation rule, which already contains only a Small Block ticket.
The obsolete Big Block metadata counter was already removed, and message 210 does not require a further change to the remaining Small Block counter, badges, or referral-code metadata.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already updates the About-page mechanics and vision copy to the one-ticket, $500-per-100-sales model.
Message 210 does not discuss NFT resale or transfer behavior, and the generic rule that active prize tickets transfer remains valid unchanged.
